title: SuffOC Champs 2016
text: This year's SuffOC Champs will be held at WAOC's event at Mildenhall North on 6th November. The event is also part of the EA League series & your designated course will be the same for both competitions. Details of the event can be found here (you can pre-enter via Fabian4) & info about the SuffOC Champs is here.
